summary: Verified SEO migration for the 4 Apollo Builders service pages (/new-home-builds, /home-renovations, /kitchen-renovations, /bathroom-renovations). All 4 render as dedicated pages via ServicePage.jsx with correct data-testid=service-page-<slug>, exact SEO titles, H1 with trailing period, breadcrumb 'Services / {H1}', canonical link ending in /{slug}/, and one JSON-LD @graph script containing Service + BreadcrumbList + LocalBusiness. Hero CTA and final 'Get A Free Quote' CTA both link to /contact-us; 'View Our Projects' links to /our-projects. Bathroom page additionally shows Compliance + Service Area sections (Before & After section also present — the source data has 'Before & After' which React escapes to 'Before & After' in HTML source, but visible text is correct — verified in screenshot). All 6 related project pages (drouin, berwick, clyde, bentleigh-east, endevour-hills, altona-meadows) return 200 with H1. All 13 regression routes (/, /about-us, /contact-us, /our-projects, /kitchen-renovation-landing, /renovation-quote, /consult, /burnt-by-builders, /thank-you, /thanks, /suburbs/brighton, /resources, /services) return 200 with H1 present. Legacy redirects /about→/about-us, /contact→/contact-us, /services/new-home-builds→/new-home-builds all update the address bar. Sitemap.xml serves 200 and contains all 4 trailing-slash service URLs. Robots.txt serves 200 with Allow: /. Nothing regressed vs iteration_17. Testing was frontend-only per request; backend not re-tested.
critical_code_review_comments: ServicePage.jsx correctly derives slug from useLocation and dispatches to servicePages[slug]; unknown slug redirects to /services — good defensive default.
JSON-LD @graph combines Service + BreadcrumbList + LocalBusiness in a single script tag per SEO best practice.
Canonical URL is normalised to trailing slash to match Yoast/live site (verified via SEO.jsx path normalisation).
servicePages.js content is verbatim from the live site including intentional misspelling 'endevour-hills' preserved for URL parity.
Bathroom-specific sections (beforeAfter, complianceSection, serviceArea) are gated behind optional data keys — clean conditional rendering.
relatedProjects arrays cover all 6 required project slugs across the 4 service pages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 42/42 assertions passed (1 apparent failure was a test-side HTML-entity false positive; text renders correctly)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 service pages now have the required Service + BreadcrumbList + LocalBusiness JSON-LD via serviceSchema()/breadcrumbSchema()/localBusiness() helpers in SEO.jsx. When asserting text containing '&' in HTML source, remember React escapes it to '&' — either use page.locator(':has-text("Before & After")') or query text_content of a locator, not page.content(). CDN images to apollobuilders.com.au are blocked from the pod (expected) so use wait_until='domcontentloaded' not 'networkidle'.
